hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_G0001 = F(p,q); A_G0002 = limit_{q -> p} F(p,q); A_G0003 = d/dp F(p,q)
required_assumptions: s(p) and s(q) are defined for p != q in F(p,q)
s is differentiable at p for the limit and derivative operations
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The catalog expressions share the first divided difference F(p,q) = (s(p)-s(q))/(p-q). G0001 is the identity instance, G0002 is the point-coalescence limit, and G0003 is the p-derivative of the same latent two-point function.

required_assumptions: s is sufficiently differentiable for Hermite divided differences with repeated nodes
p and q are treated as interpolation nodes
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog members are the first divided difference, the first derivative as a repeated-node first divided difference, and the second Hermite divided difference of the same univariate function s. This gives a single interpolation-family explanation.
